card.title: Nintendo Switch No Backlight Repair

claims.statement: Switch no backlight: confirm the image with a flashlight, check the backlight connector for corrosion, and check TPS61163A (back side) for corrosion/shorts.

procedure: Replace TPS61163A if corroded or shorted.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
